title: Optimising VLM Harnesses to Localise Errors in Generated Videos
title_zh: 优化视觉语言模型工作流以定位生成视频中的错误
abstract_en: Identifying subtle errors in generated videos is an important step toward automated video generation, where errors must be detected to assess and refine generated clips. Recent work shows that pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) can localise such errors, but their effectiveness depends strongly on the workflow used: choices about which frames to inspect, which tools and model calls to make, and how to combine predictions can lead to substantially different results. We study VLM harnesses for video error localisation. Instead of relying on manually designed harnesses, we propose Harness Search and Merge (HSM), an algorithm that automatically constructs them by searching over executable evaluation programs. An LLM orchestrator refines candidate harnesses independently on random training subsets, records findings in a memory, and constructively merges complementary candidates. We evaluate HSM on Spotlight, a recently proposed benchmark for localising errors in generated videos. HSM achieves 0.234 +- 0.012 F1, exceeding the strongest benchmark strategy (0.173 +- 0.016), and retains its lead on an unseen video generator (0.213 +- 0.008 versus 0.140 +- 0.003). On IPV-Bench, it achieves strong localisation performance with lower false-alarm rates than existing optimisation baselines. Together, these results show that searching over complete VLM harnesses can outperform existing evaluation strategies, transfer to an unseen video generator, and reduce false alarms on real videos.
abstract_zh: 定位生成视频中的细微错误，是自动评估和改进视频生成结果的重要一步。预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）能够定位这类错误，但效果高度依赖评估工作流（harness），包括检查哪些帧、如何调用工具与模型，以及如何汇总预测。论文提出 Harness Search and Merge（HSM），通过搜索可执行的评估程序自动构建工作流，替代人工设计。HSM 由大语言模型（LLM）协调，在随机抽取的训练子集上独立改进候选工作流，将经验写入记忆模块，再合并优势互补的候选方案。在 Spotlight 上，HSM 的 F1 为 0.234 ± 0.012，高于基准中表现最佳的策略（0.173 ± 0.016）；面对未见过的视频生成器，HSM 仍保持领先（0.213 ± 0.008 对比 0.140 ± 0.003）。在 IPV-Bench 上，HSM 在保持较强定位性能的同时，比现有优化基线更少对真实视频产生误报。
key_points_zh: 优化对象是完整的 VLM 评估工作流，涵盖帧选择、工具与模型调用以及预测汇总。
HSM 在随机训练子集上独立改进候选工作流，记录经验，再合并优势互补的方案。
在 Spotlight 上，HSM 将 F1 从最强基准策略的 0.173 提升至 0.234；换用未见过的视频生成器后，仍以 0.213 对 0.140 领先。
在 IPV-Bench 上，HSM 保持较强的错误定位性能，并降低了真实视频上的误报率。
